summary: The weekend after Delta Reign and the 30th Celebration launch was still about lines, sold-out shelves and scalpers: Target staff trolling resellers, overnight waits, and people holding spots for family. Solflare followed up on the limited-time FIRE POKE pack ("the fire poke is fireeeee", 45 likes) and CryptoGrit posted a friendly rip of a Japanese 1st Edition Sceptile PSA 9, saying he liked the artwork before he knew what he pulled. Collector Crypt showed a Cycol 2.0 pop-up and a third-party post highlighted its GrailBreak partnership; Courtyard led one weekly NFT sales ranking at $8.54M and posted a relatable cashier-thought-this-was-for-my-kid meme. On the risk side, a parent alleged Arena Club sold packs to their underage son and refused a refund, and Tilt Rips claimed a $750k Ferrari Gengar pull from a $150 pack — both reminders to keep 18+ clear and skip jackpot or dollar framing.

sources_note: Data from the x connector's full-archive post search and news search, covering 09:00 UTC on 7 Nov to 09:00 UTC on 8 Nov 2026 (10:00 Europe/Madrid both days). Likes, reposts, replies, quotes and follower counts are public_metrics as returned at fetch time; impressions quoted where noted. The generic pack-opening search was flooded by Tradeify referral spam, which was skipped. A payments search for Apple Pay / Google Pay collectible buying turned up almost nothing useful. No notable Watch.fun, Rip.fun, Jupiter Packs, Phygitals, Topps digital, Disney Pinnacle or NBA Top Shot product posts in the window. Third-party sales, volume and prize figures are unverified. New creators were checked against collector-base.csv and recent archive files.
